de.abas.erp.common.type.enums

Enum EnumWorkOrderType

  • Object
    • Enum<EnumWorkOrderType>
      • EnumWorkOrderType
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AbasEnum, AbasType, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable<EnumWorkOrderType>

    public enum EnumWorkOrderType
extends Enum<EnumWorkOrderType>
implements AbasEnum
    This java enum represents the standard abas erp enumeration Work order type (A279).
    It is independent from a specific ERP client.
